map.按科目自动归类错题，记录错误原因与掌握状态，到期自动提醒重练。数据保存在本地浏览: Auto-categorize wrong questions by subject, record the error reason and mastery status, and auto-remind review when due. Data is saved in the local browser.
map.📖 查看「错题本管理 使用指南」: View the Wrong-Question Notebook User Guide
map.结构化收录错题：按科目、题型（选择/填空/解答/计算）、错误原因、正确答案与复习: Structured collection: register by subject, question type (multiple choice / fill-in / short answer / calculation), error reason, correct answer, and review status to build a searchable personal wrong-question bank, leaving paper copying behind.
map.按条件筛选复习：按科目或状态（未掌握/复习中/已掌握）过滤，考前只刷「未掌握」与: Filter by condition: filter by subject or status (not mastered / reviewing / mastered) and only drill “not mastered” and “reviewing” questions before exams to boost efficiency.
map.间隔复习提醒：记录每题复习间隔天数，按遗忘曲线安排复看，避免「会了就丢」导致考场: Spaced-review reminders: record each question’s review-interval days and schedule re-viewing by the forgetting curve, avoiding “learned then dropped” causing repeated exam mistakes.
map.示例：收录一道数学计算错题: Example: collect a math calculation wrong question
map.科目「数学」、题型「计算」、题干「求 ∫₀¹ x² dx」、错误原因「积分上下限: Subject “Math”, type “Calculation”, problem “evaluate ∫₀¹ x² dx”, error reason “wrong substitution of integral limits”, correct answer “1/3”, status “Reviewing”, review interval 3 days; filter in the notebook by “Subject=Math + Status=Reviewing” to list it; when due (last time +3 days) it prompts review, and a correct re-view can change status to “Mastered”.
map.错题本数据存在哪里？安全吗？: Where is the notebook data stored? Is it safe?
map.数据保存在浏览器本机 localStorage，不联网、不上传，换设备/清缓存会: Data is stored in the browser’s local localStorage, no network, no upload; switching devices / clearing cache loses it; for important content, export and back up regularly. It is positioned as a personal study aid, with no account or cloud sync.
map.怎样用错题本效率最高？: How to use the notebook most efficiently?
map.坚持「三要素」：错因要具体（不是「粗心」而是「积分上下限代入错」）、答案要完整、: Stick to the “three elements”: the error reason must be specific (not “careless” but “wrong integral-limit substitution”), the answer complete, and the status updated with review; combined with spaced review (e.g. increasing 1/3/7 days) it converts better to long-term memory than one-time copying. This tool is only a management aid; the study method must be maintained by yourself.
map.错题本管理是一款教育学习领域的在线工具。: Wrong-Question Notebook is an online tool in the education and learning domain.
